title: 脱欧十年：英国付出了什么代价？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: There are certain days that change the world.
Brexit was one of those days.
British people will have the final say in an inout referendum.
segments.zh: 英国人民将在入欧公投中拥有最终决定权。

segments.en: Watch out, here we go. One story done in the news today, and it is Brexit.
segments.zh: 注意了，开始了。今天的新闻头条就是脱欧。

segments.en: Brexit. Brexit. Brexit. Brexit. But what has been one of the most divisive votes?
segments.zh: 脱欧。脱欧。脱欧。但这是最具分裂性的投票之一吗？

segments.en: It was staggering. History unfolding before our very eyes.
segments.zh: 令人震惊。历史在我们眼前展开。

segments.en: The population at large doesn't trust the establishment.
segments.zh: 广大民众不信任建制派。

segments.en: The best human dependence. Brexit changed the way that politics is done, not only in the UK, but beyond that too.
segments.zh: 最佳人类依赖。脱欧改变了政治运作方式，不仅在英国，在其他地方也是如此。

segments.en: People want to take their country back. Passions that are not you need to Britain.
segments.zh: 人们想夺回自己的国家。这种激情并非英国独有。

segments.en: Vote out and it turns. It was a real once in a lifetime moment.
segments.zh: 投票脱欧，结果如此。这真是千载难逢的时刻。

segments.en: But also sort of manifestly an act of economic self-harm.
segments.zh: 但显然也是一种经济上的自残行为。

segments.en: Thing is, not everyone in their dog arrived at the polling station with an economics textbook in hand.
segments.zh: 问题是，并非每个选民都带着经济学教科书去投票站。

segments.en: Or poor. It's not even the main thing that mattered to a lot of people who voted to leave.
segments.zh: 对许多投脱欧票的人来说，经济甚至不是主要考量。

segments.en: A cosmopolitan elite had been trying to redefine Britain as a multi-cultural, multi-racial, multi-ethnic society.
segments.zh: 全球化的精英们一直试图将英国重塑为多元文化、多种族的社会。

segments.en: And the Brexitist said no. We are a particular people, a product of a particular history, with a particular set of roots.
segments.zh: 而脱欧派说不，我们是一个独特的民族，有独特的历史和根基。
我们夺回了自己的国家。
